description: This file defines the Statistical class which provides a collection of statistical functions and distributions, many of which are marked as deprecated in favor of newer methods in other classes. It acts as a facade that redirects calls to specialized classes handling specific statistical calculations.

classes.name: Statistical
classes.description: Provides a facade for various statistical calculations and distributions, many of which are deprecated and redirect to specific classes.

methods.name: AVEDEV
methods.description: Returns the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean. Deprecated; use Statistical\Averages::averageDeviations instead.

methods.name: AVERAGE
methods.description: Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the arguments. Deprecated; use Statistical\Averages::average.

methods.name: AVERAGEA
methods.description: Returns the average including numbers, text, and logical values. Deprecated; use Statistical\Averages::averageA.

methods.name: AVERAGEIF
methods.description: Returns the average of values within a range that meet a condition. Deprecated; use Statistical\Conditional::AVERAGEIF.

methods.name: BETADIST
methods.description: Returns the beta distribution. Deprecated; use Statistical\Distributions\Beta::distribution.

methods.name: BETAINV
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the beta distribution. Deprecated; use Statistical\Distributions\Beta::inverse.

methods.name: BINOMDIST
methods.description: Returns the binomial distribution probability. Deprecated; use Statistical\Distributions\Binomial::distribution.

methods.name: CHIDIST
methods.description: Returns the chi-squared distribution's one-tailed probability. Deprecated; use Statistical\Distributions\ChiSquared::distributionRightTail.

methods.name: CHIINV
methods.description: Returns the inverse chi-squared distribution. Deprecated; use Statistical\Distributions\ChiSquared::inverseRightTail.

methods.name: CONFIDENCE
methods.description: Returns the confidence interval for a population mean. Deprecated; use Statistical\Confidence::CONFIDENCE.

methods.name: CORREL
methods.description: Returns the covariance or correlation. Deprecated; use Statistical\Trends::CORREL.
